sentences.en: My brother-in-law is ready to lose his temper at trifles.
sentences.zh: 我妹夫对小事就要发火。

sentences.en: I can't take this anymore. I've lost my temper completely.
sentences.zh: 我忍无可忍。我已经完全失去耐心了。

sentences.en: There's no need to get so angry. Keep your temper.
sentences.zh: 别这么生气了，控制住自己的情绪。

senses.zh: 脾气；（钢等）回火；性情；倾向
调和；锻炼；使缓和；使回火
